product_one_liner.value: Alice helps organizations building generative AI applications, agents, and foundation models test, protect, and monitor those systems against attacks, unsafe outputs, and policy violations.
product_one_liner.notes: The product page identifies the intended builders, the test/protect/monitor functions, and the attacks and unsafe behaviors addressed. Source: https://alice.io/llm

pricing_page.notes: The homepage navigation/footer has no pricing link and directs prospects to book a demo; the checked pricing URL did not yield a public pricing page. The pricing listing also reports no listed plans. Sources: https://alice.io/ ; https://www.trustradius.com/products/activefence/pricing

eng_blog.notes: Two qualifying build posts were identified: Jonathan Lavon's data-lake architecture article, explicitly identifying him as Principal Engineer, and Noam Levy's data-model/schema article. Levy's employment profile establishes his ActiveFence engineering background. public_docs.notes: The public documentation portal provides WonderSuite and content-moderation guides, integrations documentation, and API documentation—not just a single FAQ. Source: https://docs.activefence.com/

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live Principal Data Scientist posting explicitly says the company is hiring and includes an application action. Source: https://alice.io/positions/position-49_473
